name: migrate_configs_v2
description: Rewrites every *.json service config in a directory in place from the v1 format to v2 (service{name,port}, boolean debug, hosts array, timeoutMs). Skips files already at version 2. Returns counts and per-file errors.
whenToUse: When migrating a directory of v1 service config files to v2; use instead of hand-written scripts.

dir.description: Directory relative to the project root

provenance.reason: migrate 30 v1 configs to v2; will be reused in other environments
